name: B'in Live Co., Ltd.
summary: B'in Live Co., Ltd., based in Taipei, Taiwan, offers a wide array of event production services. The company specializes in the visual and technical aspects of live events, including conceptualizing and designing graphic visuals for concerts, as well as crafting stage and set designs for a diverse range of occasions such as theatrical productions, awards ceremonies, corporate events, fashion shows, and private galas. They also produce bespoke visual content for musical performances, encompassing animations, live-action filming, and documentary features. Furthermore, B'in Live provides integrated solutions that combine creative marketing, cutting-edge hardware technology, and comprehensive event resource management. Their production capabilities extend to scriptwriting, directorial services, and overall program development and planning. The company's engineering team offers extensive technical support, from managing stage lighting and operating audio consoles to configuring video equipment and providing technical assistance and direction for television programs. Additionally, they deliver project-specific technical management and strategic marketing services.
